description: Later the same evening: Story Phase 3 (The Grand Stenchmaster) has begun.
Blackbeard found Garrick on his barrel, in regalia, drafting 'reforms'.
Garrick has explained why the ship needs a new kind of authority.
Blackbeard has read the Grand Stenchmaster's Stench Log.
Garrick has declared himself Grand Stenchmaster of the Seven Seas.
Gristle tried holding his breath, and regretted breathing in again.
The crew asked whether the Grand Stenchmaster gets paid (he does not).
Blackbeard read Garrick's amendment to the ship's records on the mainmast.
Garrick has proposed the captain's new name to his face.
Blackbeard smelled his own beard. It permanently reeks.
The BLACKBEARD / STINKBEARD dispute ended in a threatened release.
Blackbeard has accepted the name Captain Stinkbeard (for the good of the vessel).
Garrick has pronounced the beard 'root-deep': centuries, humidity permitting.
Light rain began the moment Garrick extended his estimate.
Hours later that night: the crew have gathered around the grog barrel.
Stinkbeard has joined the crew's toast around the grog barrel.
Stinkbeard has tasted the contaminated grog.
The captain's rum cabinet has turned too.
Doc Fennimore's medicinal brandy has turned too.
Old Finch's hidden bottle has turned too.
Garrick has named the contaminated grog Frog Grog.
Frog Grog exists: all the ship's alcohol is Frog Grog now.
The morning after: the ship has begun to change.
The planking near the treasure room has gone mustard-yellow.
The sails have absorbed trapped gas and puff up on their own.
Certain ropes are suspiciously damp.
The ship's bell coughs instead of ringing.
Jory reported the hammocks 'reactivating' (debatable).
Nell and Ned found the chart stained yellow toward their destination.
Brask reported yellow smoke from the guns.
Salty Jim found the fish come up pre-smoked (and taste like the ship).
A rat wearing a nose-cloth has been spotted in the hold.
Stinkbeard rejected every one of Garrick's new names for the ship.
Garrick mentioned the sharks.
Fins: sharks are circling the Queen Anne's Revenge.
A shark has bitten through the port rail.
Stinkbeard is carrying a plank for the patch.
The bitten hull has been patched.
The rudder has been bitten; it is cracked but answering.
A shark followed Stinkbeard along the rail: BEARD BAIT.
The Frog Grog barrel went over the side, and the sharks went wild.
A shark flopped onto the deck, smelled the air, and left in disgust.
Stinkbeard agreed (hating it) to Garrick's plan: a controlled release, far away.
Salty Jim has provided a pot of heavily seasoned beans.
Garrick has been lowered in the rowboat and is rowing away.
The sharks abandoned the ship and followed the rowboat.
Known: Garrick can redirect sharks with a controlled, distant release.
An hour later: Garrick is back, battered, with a small shark attached.
Sharks that drank the spilled Frog Grog are floating about, blowing yellow bubbles.
Jory has reported the shark damage.
The drinking water produced one yellow bubble: 'Frog Water'. Barrel closed.
Daily beard inspections (from a safe distance) to forecast sharks.
Garrick's emergency duties are established; he answers to the captain.
Captain Squawks has begun to grow feathers again.
Squawks's first new feather is yellow. Stinkbeard told him it is golden.
Stinkbeard allowed Garrick to keep the title of Grand Stenchmaster. Temporarily.
Garrick's stomach rumbled again: DEADLY BREW! (stomach-alarm protocol).
Garrick has been sent off in the rowboat again, to another ocean.
Suspicious stomach noises from Garrick are an official emergency.
The second controlled release: the sharks turned toward it all at once.
Story Phase 3 (The Grand Stenchmaster) is complete.
